newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar sluggish, ends lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar sluggish, ends lower.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures remained low-key during Monday evening trading, with the market finishing softer and at the lows.

Traders said lower New York levels were an influence, although London prices had been trending down towards $326.00 support, basis October, earlier in the session. This level held today, but may be pierced in coming sessions, they added.
October closed down $1.30 at $326.00, with December also finishing $1.30 easier at $321.50. Volume was a thin 820 lots.
In Paris, October ended $1.50 easier at $325.70.
